_comment: Reconstruction of a real hotkey press: three windows on a 1728x1085 laptop display, run with --master 0.6. The hero takes 1033px, leaving 687px of stack - narrower than VS Code's 800px useful width, so Code is stowed despite the desktop having ample room for all three without a master pane. The mirror image of issue #9: the slab is sized without asking whether the remainder can hold anyone.
